where Cust_UniId is not null
and Product_UniId is not null

select * from dscc.Wave2_KPI_Customer_StockCover_M
where  dt >= add_months(trunc(current_date(),'MM'), -1)
and dt <= from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(current_date(), 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')

source.query:
select * from dscc.wave2_kpi_market_return
where Product_UniId is not null

select * from dscc. wave2_kpi_overdue_detail T1
inner join (select max(dt) from dscc. wave2_kpi_overdue_detail) T2
on T1.dt = T2.dt
where T1.Payer_Cust_UniId is not null
and T1.Soldto_Cust_UniId is not null
